resifuse_supervised.critical_boundary: Source fine-tune preprocessing creates windows centered on label-positive segments and scores frames with any positive grouped label. Excluded all-zero frames may be annotated negatives or unannotated; the resulting foreground-conditioned F1 cannot measure background false alarms. Label-independent Agent Test input and owner-only positive-frame eligibility are required; this changes input/windowing and prevents exact ResiFuse paper comparison. The 0.5 sigmoid threshold itself is present in the source scorer.
